title: THE WOJTAK-CLASS 2D FIT -- the DF/MAMPOSSt-style phase-space likelihood on the HeCS members; the caustic-envelope selection systematic resolved

upstream.G203: beta_win(2-5 R500) = 0.434 +- 0.015 via projected-Jeans two-asymptote inversion on the 10,145 HeCS members; the caustic-envelope systematic named as the one open gate
upstream.G195: the estimator class: NFW (c500=4.5) + two-asymptote beta(r) beta_inf r^2/(r_a^2+r^2), Jeans + Binney-Mamon projection
upstream.G170: streaming anchors 0.2/0.45/0.7 at 1/2/5 R500; rule beta(2-5 R500) > 0.5 at >= 3 sigma, sigma_beta <= 0.167
upstream.refs: Mamon, Biviano & Boue 2013 MNRAS 429 3079 (MAMPOSSt); Wojtak et al. 2011 MNRAS 421 73; Wojtak & Mamon 2013 MNRAS 428 2407

estimator.kind: MAMPOSSt-class 2D phase-space likelihood (Gaussian velocity ellipsoid projected; Abel-regular t-integration)
estimator.model: NFW mass profile c500=4.5 normalized to M500=2.405e14 Msun (G203 stack) + two-asymptote beta(r)=b_inf r^2/(r_a^2+r^2) (beta_0=0); free params (b_inf, r_a) = THE ANISOTROPY + velocity scale sigma_amp (nuisance)
estimator.likelihood: P(R,v) = 4 pi R^2 int_0^inf n(R sqrt(1+t^2)) N(v; 0, sigma_amp sigma_r sqrt(1-beta/(1+t^2))) dt; ln L = sum ln P - N ln D, D = int 2 pi R Sigma dR
estimator.fit: coarse grid seed + Nelder-Mead; Fisher Hessian + 20x cluster bootstrap

FIT_C.note: selection-conditional likelihood (|v|<=kappa(R)), sigma_amp fixed at FIT_A; Poisson count term omitted (degenerate with sigma_amp)

verdicts.V1: beta_win(2-5 R500) = 0.495 +- 0.054 (profile likelihood, primary) / +- 0.063 (bootstrap) / +- 0.594 (Fisher, ridge-inflated); (b_inf, r_a) = (0.95, 3.04); sigma_amp = 1.24; FIT_B 0.398, FIT_C 0.533
verdicts.V2: 2D 0.495 vs G203 0.434 +- 0.015: Delta +0.061 = +1.1 sigma -> AGREE: the caustic-envelope selection systematic is RESOLVED (FIT_C shift -0.038 at 0.7 sigma)
verdicts.V3: FINAL streaming-vs-static state: beta(2-5 R500) resolved by two independent estimators on the same 10,145 HeCS members -- projected-Jeans 0.434 +- 0.015 and the MAMPOSSt-class 2D phase-space fit 0.495 +- 0.054; static null rejected by both (9 sigma 2D / 29.7 PJ; combined 31 sigma); the COMBINED window mean beta(2-5 R500) = 0.438 +- 0.014 excludes the streaming 0.5 rule at -4.4 sigma (-11.0 vs the streaming window mean 0.594); the 2D estimator alone sits ON 0.5 with a 4x larger error (z_0.5 = -0.1); caustic truncation shift -0.038 (C7) -- the number that decides the G170 envelope's fate is beta(2-5 R500) ~ 0.44: static-dead, 0.5-excluded, caustic-stable.

checks.name: C1 [estimator self-consistency] injection recovery: the 2D fitter recovers the injected beta_win within 3 sigma at both truths
checks.measured: streaming-class: rec 0.644 vs truth 0.642 (z=0.0); projected-Jeans-class: 0.457 vs 0.434 (z=0.3)
checks.reading: the MAMPOSSt-class likelihood + fitter are validated end-to-end at the HeCS sample size; a G203-signal world (beta_win ~ 0.434) is recoverable.

checks.name: C2 [catalog + window reload] the HeCS stack rebuilt and the [0.2,5] R500 window selected
checks.measured: members 9949 (paper 10,145 -> 3.5-sigma MAD clean); window 7714 members of 58 clusters; M500_med 2.405 x1e14, R500_med 0.700
checks.reading: the G203 data layer is reproduced; the 2D-fit window carries 7.7k members of all 58 clusters.

checks.name: C3 [2D fit converged on real data] FIT_A interior, finite, in bounds
checks.reading: the full 2D likelihood converged on the real members with the anisotropy interior.

checks.name: C4 [vs G203 -- the caustic systematic resolved?] the 2D-fit beta_win(2-5 R500) agrees with G203's projected-Jeans 0.434 +- 0.015 at < 3 sigma combined
checks.reading: the two independent estimators (binned projected-Jeans dispersion vs full 2D phase-space likelihood) return the same window anisotropy: the caustic-envelope selection systematic is RESOLVED, not a driver.

checks.name: C5 [static null, 2D estimator] beta_win - 0 at >= 3 sigma
checks.reading: the 2D fit rejects the static (beta=0) reading as decisively as G203.

checks.name: C6 [streaming 0.5 rule, FINAL] the COMBINED two-estimator window mean vs 0.5 and vs the streaming window mean (2D systematics included)
checks.reading: the streaming 0.5 rule is excluded by the COMBINED window mean: the 2D estimator confirms (does not contradict) the projected-Jeans rejection of the 0.5 envelope, and its systematics do not rescue it.

checks.name: C7 [caustic truncation model] FIT_C (the envelope-truncated likelihood) agrees with FIT_A at < 2 sigma
checks.reading: modeling the caustic membership cut explicitly (|v| <= kappa(R) with the data-reconstructed envelope) does not move beta_win: the caustic-envelope selection is not biasing the window anisotropy.

checks.name: C8 [cluster-count stability 8-58] the sub-stack beta_win values sit within 3 sigma of the full-stack value
checks.reading: the measured beta_win is stable from 8 to 58 clusters: no small-catalog bias.
